to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
HOOKS, DURAL 




1. Scope— Covers materiel, dimensions and other requirements for sharp and blunt dural hooks 
used in Neurosurgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 and Fig. 2. 

2.1 The tolerance on various dimensions shall be permitted as given below: 
± 0*2 mm for dimensions up to 2 mm; 
± 0*5 mm for dimensions above 2 mm and up to 5 mm; 
± 1'0 mm for dimensions above 5 mm and up to 20 mm; 
± 2'5 mm for dimensions above 20 mm and up to 100 mm; and 
± 5'0 mm for dimensions above 100 mm and up to 200 mm. 

3. Materials — The dural hooks shall be made of stainless steel conforming to Designation 30CM3 
of IS : 6603-1972 'Specification for stainless steel bars and flats', 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The dural hook shall be forged in one piece. 

4.2 The hook shank shall be well drawn and uniformly tapered. The working end of sharp hook 
shall be bent to form a uniform segment of a circle. The working end of blunt hook shall be 
flattened and shaped as shown in Fig. 2. 

4.3 The handle shall be solid type. It shall be properly made and free from surface and other 
defects. All edges of the handle shall be suitably rounded off. 

4.4 The surfaces of the hook shall be smoothly finished. The finished instrument shall be well 
balanced and symmetrical on its central axis. It shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Heat Treatment 

5.1 The shank portion of the hook shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 430 
to 490 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 View Under Magnification —The hook end shall be examined under a magnification of between 
X 5 and X 10. The hook end shall be well defined and free from defects visible under 
magnification. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance Test — The instrument shall satisfy the boiling and autoclaving test as 
specified in IS: 7531-1975 'Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of 
stainless steel surgical instruments'. 

7. Marking — Each instrument shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name 
initials, or recognized trade-mark and the words'SS' or 'Stainless Steel' on the handle. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 10 August 1981
